summary: Global Cord Blood Corp, a Cayman Islands company in provisional liquidation since September 22, 2022, filed a Form 6-K reporting its joint provisional liquidators' (JPLs) third fee report covering October 1, 2024 to September 30, 2025. The JPLs, from Grant Thornton, are seeking Court sanction of their fees after prior Court approvals for earlier periods were obtained despite shareholder disputes over the register of members. The filing includes a letter to purported shareholders notifying them of the fee report and the JPLs' intention to provide copies to evidenced holders. This is a routine liquidation-process update.
